question: What powers of speech and form can a practitioner swiftly attain through this practice?
premises: The practitioner may become lord of speeches.
The practitioner may assume a desire-form.
inference: The practice grants swift mastery over speech and a captivating form.
uncertainties: kāma-rūpī may mean a form capable of assuming desired shapes or a form embodying desire.
plain_english: A person may quickly become lord of speech and take on a form of desire.
